data.name: Comfort Suites Paradise Island
data.address: SS 6202, Paradise Island Dr, Nassau, Bahamas
data.description:
On an island off Nassau, this informal all-suite hotel is a 6-minute walk from the Paradise Island Ferry Terminal and 1 km from Atlantis Paradise Island.
The warm suites offer free Wi-Fi and flat-screens, as well as tea and coffeemakers, and minifridges. They also include living areas with pull-out sofas and desks.
Complimentary perks consist of parking, a hot breakfast buffet, and access to Atlantis Paradise Island's facilities including a private beach, water park, spa and golf course. There's also a casual restaurant/bar, plus an outdoor pool with a swim-up bar.
